summary: T007 repairs the three ADR-006 import edges instead of excepting them. The shared strategy-callback contracts (StrategyDecision, StrategyDecisionRequest) and the input-event primitives (BacktestEvent, kind/source-priority constants) move from robinhood_lp.backtest.{engine,events} to the new robinhood_lp.protocol.contracts module; strategy/baselines.py and the engine / events modules now import from there. The V4 log-record dataclasses (Initialize/ModifyLiquidity/Swap/Donate/ProtocolFeeUpdated LogRecord) move to the new robinhood_lp.protocol.records module; replay/replayer.py and replay/ticks.py now import from there, and storage/schema.py subclasses extend the protocol base classes so the storage adapter still produces the same records for the same raw input. The hook-flag bit constants (ALL_HOOK_MASK, DELTA_TO_ACTION_FLAG, DYNAMIC_FEE_FLAG, HOOK_FLAG_BITS) move to robinhood_lp.protocol.ids; hook_pack.py now imports them from the protocol layer instead of config.models. The hook_pack -> config.models suppression entry in docs/implement/ci/suppressions.toml is deleted; the other Owner-deferred entries for the unclassified packages are left untouched. The new regression test tests/test_layer_direction_t007.py parses every src/robinhood_lp/**/*.py file with stdlib ast and fails if any of the three edges is reintroduced; a probe run that temporarily reintroduced the strategy->backtest import produced the expected failure. The stale citation in docs/implement/DOCUMENTATION_INTEGRITY_AUDIT.md §8.1 is updated to mark the three sites repaired (T007) and the reproduction snippet is extended with the new regression test command. All five required test suites pass (tests/test_layer_direction_t007.py, tests/test_replay_t040.py, tests/test_tick_liquidity_t041.py, tests/test_hook_pack_t043.py, tests/test_strategy_t062.py — 206 / 206). pytest, ruff check, ruff format --check, and strict mypy on every changed src/test file all pass with no issues. The deterministic import-graph check (python -m tools.check_imports check) returns no findings. Recorded outputs of the engine, replay and hook pack are preserved: the storage-side record classes extend the protocol-side base classes so the field set is identical, the original backtest.{engine,events} modules re-export the canonical types so existing callers see the same frozen dataclass instances, and the hook flag-bit values re-exported from config.models match the protocol-side canonical definitions (verified equality at import time). No product behaviour, public interface semantics, numeric results, reason codes, error classes, modules, imports, or §2.2 rows were changed; no docs/spec/, task contract, tools/workflow/, .claude/, todo/schemas/, or todo/config.yaml (other than the mechanical IN_DEVELOPMENT status and attempt counter for T007 itself) was edited; no third-party dependency was added.
